title: Slayeth Wolves, Verily
description: Slayeth Wolves, Verily — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Lee of York

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 6 Dew Valley Wolves and 12 Dew Valley Pups, then return to Sir Lee of York in Dew Valley.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Lee of York

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Wolf Pelts

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 6 Dew Valley Wolves and 12 Dew Valley Pups, then return to Sir Lee of York in Dew Valley.

Offer:

What ticket number did you have...no, wait, never mind. I don't even care.

I've been standing here forever, and for what? For *what*? Don't bother answering. I'm being rhetorical.

So what do you want from me?

You want a quest? From me? Seriously? Wow. It's been so long...let's see...okay, I may be a bit rusty, but here I go.

Um, forsooth, valiant Dungeon Runner! Wolves and their pups have been slaying good citizens of the realm in Dew Valley Forest. Travel there swiftly, slay them, and, uh, returneth to me.

Afterward, er, I shall reward thee with a goodly amount of...rewards.''

Tip: If you have not finished the new player tutorial, you can return to where you left off at any time, even if you accept this quest from Sir Lee of York.

Turn-in:

'Um, zounds! That shall teacheth those wolves! I am unsure what it shall teacheth them...but that is beside, uh, mine point.'

Objectives:

  • Slay Dew Valley Wolves
  • Slay Dew Valley Pups

Level range: 1–5
